name: 一覧表示の切り替え帯
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Generate one Japanese Lighthouse component LH09-0003 一覧表示の切り替え帯.
Hierarchy: Image1 is ORIGINAL and controls icon glyph geometry, optical stroke, proportions, alignment, spacing and small control anatomy. Image2 is our SECONDARY Japanese content/layout guide with rough substitute glyphs and an omitted control: correct these using ORIGINAL. Image3 is approved materials/style only; never copy its bus content.
A single compact horizontal toolbar on #FFFFFF, with three left-aligned rounded pills: 「すべて」「実行中」「未着手」. First selected; adapt original neutral selected fill into a restrained forest-green135deg gradient #174C36 -> #1F6444 -> #2D8F5E, white regular label. Other two white with fine neutral border and slate text. Immediately after these pills restore ORIGINAL small diamond/stack outline containing a plus, the saved-view action omitted by the mock.
Large flexible space, then exactly THREE small round white outlined buttons aligned right. Copy ORIGINAL icons accurately: filter = three centered descending horizontal strokes; display/settings = two horizontal sliders with small round knobs at different xpositions; split-panel = rounded rectangle outline with a vertical partition near right edge. All #526173 supporting glyphs, consistent thin stroke and original relative size. No textual substitutes such as equals sign, grid character or generic menu. Do not add labels to icon buttons, menu content or extra controls.
Preserve original compact spacing, pill proportions and baseline alignment at960x48 logical dimensions. Use Meiryo Regular14/24, zero tracking; no oversized bold text. Pure white canvas and toolbar, tiny soft downward control shadows, restrained neutral borders, no nested card wrapping. No mint fill, broad green tint or random accents. Green communicates selection only, supported by filled-vs-outline shape. Tightly frame the component with minimal white padding. Japanese text exactly as specified. This is only a static design candidate.
reviewNotes: 原画像の保存ビュー/絞り込み/スライダー/分割パネルを復元し実見。日本語三状態と選択緑を確認。ラベルがRegular指定より太く、上下余白も過大なため要修正。原画像優先、モック補助。元の中立選択色をブランド緑へ変更し補助はスレート。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
